Name: Hedge
Company description: Hedge is a fintech company developing tools, strategies and products that simplify investing in crypto markets. The legal entity is incorporated in Zug, Switzerland, with team spanning from Switzerland, Slovenia, to South Africa. Hedge has an experienced team with traditional and alternative finance backgrounds. Strategic partnerships with Rialto.ai , Buchman AG and industry association with Crypto Valley Zug, Switzerland , give Hedge the edge in intellectual resources. Hedge’s product offering rests on 3 pillars: ·       Comprehensive crypto indexation in cooperation with Buchman AG , Liechtenstein, ·       Introduction of Crypto Traded Indices™ - Crypto ETF-like instruments (tradable ERC20 tokenized index funds) ·       Development of an institutional-grade trading platform with order-matching and settlement engine by orders of magnitude faster than the current industry standard, while following strict security and legal standards. The flagship index BC30 tracks the development of top 30 cryptocurrencies and assets by free-float market capitalization and is currently being streamed through Hedge’s own website and Thomson Reuters Eikon terminal, as well as onboarding to Morningstar and others. Hedge has a family suite of Crypto indices (BC10, BC5) and will be releasing crypto-specific sector and volatility indices. The Hedge Token (HDG) is the utility token powering the Hedge Platform ecosystem.

Name: Hiveterminal Slovenia
Company description: Hiveterminal is an award-winning fintech startup creating unique relationships between liquidity providers and businesses for working capital. Using the blockchain, Hiveterminal cuts costs, automates processes, and eliminates invoice duplication to open up new sources of financial liquidity to small businesses, creating high-return investment opportunities for invoice buyers in the process.

Name: Leanpay
Company description: Leanpay, a pioneer in BNPL 3.0, empowers vendors and consumers with innovative installment payment solutions. We're committed to fueling our partners' growth and have earned trust among users. Our mission is clear: to enable any customer to buy whatever they need by providing fair, transparent, and simple financing solutions in any shop.  Simultaneously, we equip partners with tools to boost revenue through increased sales, customer attraction, higher order values, and repeat business. Focused on larger purchases up to 12,000 EUR, our platform boasts an average basket size four times larger than competitors. We prioritize customer transparency and security with fixed monthly repayment plans, preventing over-indebtedness. With 100,000+ satisfied customers and over €103 million in consumer loans issued, Leanpay collaborates with 800+ merchant partners, showcasing our impact. Join #TeamLeanpay's diverse, ambitious group of 70+ employees from 4 nationalities as we revolutionize fintech.  Our journey continues with Leanpay's expansion into Romania and Hungary, bringing success to new horizons.

Name: Petrol Pay
Company description: Petrol Pay, E-Money and Payment Services, Ltd. (Petrol Pay d.o.o.) is a Slovenian owned FinTech company, known by it's award winning mobile app and mobile platform mBills (www.mbills.si) for simple and faster smartphone payments, where user's smartphone becomes their mobile wallet. We aim for unified user experience on mobile device for all types of payments and have been awarded in 2016 as best IT project by Slovenian Professional Informatics Society (SDI - Slovensko društvo informatika). Part of Petrol Group.
